name: calc_sortino_ratio
description:
Sortino ratio: (portfolio return - risk-free rate) / downside deviation. Computed locally in Python; no API key or network.
Returns {sortino_ratio}, 4 decimals; 0 when downside deviation is 0.
Inputs (* required): portfolio_return*, risk_free_rate*, downside_deviation* (all percent over the same period).
For total volatility use calc_sharpe_ratio.
Example: {"portfolio_return": 12, "risk_free_rate": 4, "downside_deviation": 9}
